Create a production-ready single-file website in one html file.

GOAL
Build a premium event landing page for **“ARTIFACT: Museum Night”** — a ticketed night museum event with ticket selection, but no real payment.

TECH / STRICT
- One html file only.
- HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript only.
- No frameworks.
- No libraries.
- Inline CSS and inline JS.
- Remote images are allowed.
- Must work by opening the file directly in a browser.

DESIGN DIRECTION
Create a visually striking cinematic museum-night website.

The design should feel like:
- luxury museum after dark
- velvet darkness
- golden spotlights
- quiet mystery
- art-house cinema
- premium cultural event

Visual style:
- dark velvet / near-black background
- deep burgundy and midnight navy gradients
- soft spotlight effects
- elegant serif headlines
- modern readable sans-serif body text
- thin gold dividers
- subtle grain/noise overlay using CSS only
- large editorial hero layout
- asymmetric image cards
- glass-like dark panels
- premium ticket cards
- smooth hover states
- scroll reveal animations
- strong typography hierarchy

Color palette:
- Background: `#070506`
- Velvet: `#1a0710`
- Burgundy: `#3a0f1d`
- Midnight navy: `#07111f`
- Gold: `#d6ad60`
- Soft gold: `#f3d79b`
- Ivory text: `#f8efe2`
- Muted text: `#b9a999`
- Panel: `rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.06)`
- Border: `rgba(214, 173, 96, 0.28)`

TYPOGRAPHY
Use CSS font stacks only:
- Headlines: `Georgia`, `Times New Roman`, serif
- Body: `Inter`, `system-ui`, `Segoe UI`, sans-serif

LAYOUT
Single-page landing with sticky navbar and smooth scrolling.

SECTIONS

1. Navbar
- Logo: ARTIFACT
- Links:

Krakowskie Przedmieście 15, 00-071 Warsaw, Poland", travel tips, accessibility notes (step-free entrance, lifts, wheelchair loan, quiet room, ISL-interpreted artist talk), parking/public transport (Metro M2 Nowy Świat-Uniwersytet 6 min walk, bus 116/128/175, night buses N, limited parking at Plac Piłsudskiego garage, bike racks). 8. FAQ (#faq): accordion with buttons aria-expanded/aria-controls, animated height, plus/minus icon; questions: Is payment processed on this page? (button in hero generates .ics); plus "Is there a dress code?" and "Is there an age limit?".
9. Newsletter: glass panel, heading "Letters from after dark", email input with label, submit; inline validation message (aria-live), toast on success, reset.
10. Footer: logo ARTIFACT, event credits (Curated by The Old Gallery Collective, lighting, sound), social text links (Instagram, Vimeo, Spotify, Newsletter) as href="#" with aria-labels, © 2026 ARTIFACT, note "Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase." and a small "Save to Calendar" link-button too.
